historical_successes_to_reuse: Hash paper code, model config/index, calibration token IDs, captures, checkpoint manifest, evaluator and every accepted result.
Derive hybrid linear-attention layer IDs from text_config.layer_types; Qwen3.6 linear layers are not a contiguous 0-47 range.
Use bounded double-opt-in post-convolution capture and prove exact layer/rank/sample coverage before selection.
Keep baseline and derived checkpoint separate; hardlink unchanged shards and atomically replace changed shards.
Require real-weight health plus an exact completion and runtime head_k_dim evidence before benchmark.
Report every repetition and dispersion, and release the exact NPU/container/port lane at phase end.
historical_failures_to_preserve: Dk64 50% and Dk96 25% both crossed the frozen GSM8K variability boundary; a favorable LongBench mean cannot hide a failed dataset.
Dk64 and Dk96 mean serving directions were favorable but all three-run ranges overlapped; point improvements are not stable-benefit evidence.
The delivered calibration used LongBench-v2 rather than paper-original FineWeb-Edu and overlaps an evaluation family; it is an explicit adaptation and a generalization risk.
Profiling after a failed quality gate cannot rescue adoption and was correctly skipped.
Changing pruning ratio, calibration, recovery training or runtime identity requires a new experiment and fresh baseline.

new_quality_first_proposals.lesson: After a quality failure, move to the nearest hardware-aligned conservative dimension before adding recovery training.
new_quality_first_proposals.application: Dk112 removes 16 of 128 channels (12.5%) after Dk96 failed; it retains a native aligned shape while reducing perturbation.
new_quality_first_proposals.promotion_gate: Promote only if repeated Dk112 evidence changes the decision.

new_quality_first_proposals.lesson: Run quality before expensive performance/profile phases when prior candidates already failed quality.
new_quality_first_proposals.application: Fresh baseline quality and Dk112 quality precede performance. A dataset failure stops the experiment.
new_quality_first_proposals.promotion_gate: Independent artifact audit must confirm all quality rows, indexes and hashes.

new_quality_first_proposals.lesson: LoRA recovery is the paper-supported path to recover accuracy, but it is not a free post-processing step.
new_quality_first_proposals.application: If Dk112 fails or its speedup is below noise, require a separate training-capable environment, non-evaluation recovery data, merged adapter checkpoint and a new baseline/treatment identity.
new_quality_first_proposals.promotion_gate: Do not recommend LoRA execution until training data, framework, NPU memory feasibility and evaluation non-leakage are proven.
